blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables high-quality novel-view synthesis but requires substantial storage.
Existing compression methods often rely on spatial context modeling over irregular 3D representations, increasing the complexity of training and coding.
Meanwhile, floating-point context inference can introduce numerical inconsistencies across platforms, causing entropy-decoding failures.
To address these practical challenges, we propose COSA-GS, which constructs c ontext with o ut s patial a ggregation through anchor-wise causal factorization.
Specifically, we use geometry context derived from each anchor’s coordinates to model a compact learnable anchor latent.
The anchor latent is then fused with the geometry context to form an anchor context for attribute coding.
The resulting context model features a simple architecture composed solely of linear transformations and activations.
We train COSA-GS using rate–distortion optimization with adaptive Gaussian pruning. Further, we develop quantization-aware training and integer inference for the context model to achieve bit-exact consistency of entropy-decoded symbols across platforms.
Experiments demonstrate that COSA-GS achieves state-of-the-art compression performance while retaining fast and consistent cross-platform decoding, providing a simple yet effective framework for practical 3DGS compression. Code is available at https://github.com/pengpeng-yu/COSA-GS .

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables high-quality novel-view synthesis ( Kerbl et al., 2023 ) .
However, its explicit scene representation often contains numerous Gaussian primitives with associated appearance and geometry parameters, resulting in substantial storage and transmission costs.
To reduce this overhead, existing methods explore pruning, vector quantization, compact parameterizations, and entropy coding ( Bagdasarian et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh:
3D Gaussian Splating(3DGS)可以实现高质量的小说-视觉合成(Kerbl等人,2023年).
然而,其明显的场景表现经常包含众多带有相关外观和几何参数的高斯原始,导致大量的存储和传输成本.
为了减少这种间接费用,现有方法探索了推算、向量量化、紧凑参数化和 en编码(Bagdasarian等人,2025年)。

blocks.en:
An important direction is to exploit spatial correlations in the scene representation.
Scaffold-GS ( Lu et al., 2024 ) parameterizes local Gaussians using anchors and learnable offsets, and predicts their view-dependent attributes from anchor features and viewing conditions, providing a compact representation for subsequent compression methods.
Building on this representation, HAC and HAC++ query a learned hash grid at anchor locations to construct spatial context for attribute distribution modeling ( Chen et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2025 ) .
ContextGS instead organizes anchors into hierarchical levels and uses already decoded coarser anchors, together with a per-anchor hyperprior, to predict finer-level attribute distributions ( Wang et al., 2024b ) .
blocks.zh:
一个重要的方向是利用场景表现中的空间相关性.
Scaffold-GS(Lu et al., 2024) 参数化本地高斯人使用主锚和可学习的抵消,并从主锚特征和取景条件中预测其依赖视图的属性,为后续的压缩方法提供了紧凑的表示.
基于这种表述,HAC和HAC++查询锚地上一个有学识的散列网格,以构建属性分布模型的空间背景(Chen等人,2024年;Chen等人,2025年)。
背景情况 GS则将锚地组织到分级级别,并使用已经解码的coarser锚地,加上每个锚地的超前,来预测更细的级属性分布(Wang等人,2024b.).

blocks.en:
Although these methods improve compression performance, their reliance on spatial context extraction over irregular 3D structures complicates the coding pipeline and limits coding speed.
Meanwhile, floating-point context inference can introduce numerical inconsistencies across platforms, causing entropy-decoding failures ( Ballé et al., 2019 ; Koyuncu et al., 2022 ) .
This raises a practical question: can we achieve strong rate–distortion performance and fast, consistent cross-platform decoding with a simple architecture? Our intuition is that 3DGS optimization itself can reduce inter-anchor dependence when guided by an appropriate context model.
Concretely, we can encourage each anchor to learn distinctive spatial information while concentrating the remaining dependencies within individual anchors, allowing complex spatial context aggregation to be replaced by simpler anchor-wise modeling.
Note that anchor-wise does not mean discarding spatial information: the context for each anchor can still be derived from its own coordinate.
blocks.zh:
虽然这些方法提高了压缩性能,但它们依赖于空间背景提取而不规则的3D结构,使得编码管道复杂化,并限制了编码速度.
同时,浮点上下文推论可能会在平台上引入数值不一致,导致肽解码失败(Ballé等人,2019年;Koyuncu等人,2022年).
这提出了一个实际的问题:我们能否实现强大的速率—扭曲性能,以及快速,一致的跨平台解码与简单的建筑? 我们的直觉是,3DGS优化本身可以在适当的上下文模型的指导下减少宿主之间的依赖.
具体地说,我们可以鼓励每个锚点学习独特的空间信息,同时将剩余的依赖性集中在单个锚点内,使复杂的空间环境汇总能够被更简单的锚点模型化所取代.
注意,按锚不意味着丢弃空间信息:每个锚的上下文仍然可以从自己的坐标中得出.

blocks.en:
Based on this principle, we propose COSA-GS, short for C ontext with o ut S patial A ggregation for G aussian S platting.
The method organizes context construction and attribute coding into a connected causal structure within each anchor.
Coordinate-derived geometry context is used to model a compact learnable anchor latent, which is then fused with the geometry context to form an anchor context.
The anchor context supports modeling and coding across all attribute groups.
All context modeling uses only anchor-wise linear transformations and activations, yielding a simple compression architecture without spatial context aggregation.
We further develop an integer inference pipeline for the context model, with quantization-aware training to adapt the networks to integer arithmetic.
The pipeline maintains consistency throughout context construction and probability prediction, enabling consistent entropy decoding across platforms.

坐标派生的几何环境用于模拟可学习的紧凑锚基,然后结合几何环境形成锚基环境。
主机上下文支持所有属性组的建模和编码.
所有上下文建模都只使用锚定的线性转换和激活,产生一个简单的压缩架构而无需空间上下文聚合.
我们进一步为上下文模型开发整数推论管道,进行量子化-意识训练,使网络适应整数算术.
管道在整个上下文构造和概率预测中保持一致性,使各平台之间能够进行一致的 en解码。

blocks.en: Our contributions are summarized as follows: • We propose COSA-GS, a simple 3DGS compression framework that integrates context construction and attribute coding through anchor-wise causal factorization without spatial context aggregation. • We develop an integer inference pipeline with quantization-aware training for the context model, enabling consistent entropy decoding across heterogeneous platforms. • We combine the proposed model with rate–distortion optimization and adaptive masking, achieving state-of-the-art compression performance and fast decoding on Mip-NeRF360, DeepBlending, Tanks&Temples, and BungeeNeRF.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 3D Gaussian Splatting Compression
blocks.zh: 2.1 3D 高斯平板压缩

blocks.en:
The explicit scene representation of 3DGS enables efficient rendering but incurs substantial storage cost ( Kerbl et al., 2023 ) .
Recent work has explored compression and compaction through pruning, quantization, compact parameterization, and entropy coding ( Lee et al., 2024 ; Fan et al., 2024 ; Niedermayr et al., 2024 ; Girish et al., 2024 ; Papantonakis et al., 2024 ) .
Post-training and training-free methods reduce storage through pruning and compact attribute coding ( Xie et al., 2024 ; Tian et al., 2025 ) .
Predictive coding and structured feature-plane representations further reduce redundancy in Gaussian attributes ( Liu et al., 2024 ; Lee et al., 2025 ) .
Scene-adaptive lattice vector quantization improves the rate–distortion efficiency of anchor-based compression ( Xu et al., 2026 ) .
Gaussian pruning and sparsification reduce model size by removing redundant primitives ( Hanson et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ) .
Differentiable rate–distortion optimization directly balances storage cost and rendering quality during scene optimization ( Wang et al., 2024a ) .
Anchor-based parameterization represents local Gaussians with anchors and learnable offsets while predicting view-dependent attributes from anchor features and viewing conditions ( Lu et al., 2024 ) , providing a compact representation for learned 3DGS compression.
blocks.zh:
3DGS的清晰场景显示能够有效渲染,但需要大量储存费用(Kerbl等人,2023年)。
最近的工作通过挤压、量化、紧凑参数化和 en编码探索了压缩和压缩(Lee等人,2024年;Fan等人,2024年;Niedermayr等人,2024年;Girish等人,2024年;Papantonakis等人,2024年)。
培训后和无培训方法通过钻探和紧凑属性编码减少储存(Xie等人,2024年;Tian等人,2025年)。
预测的编码和结构化的地物平面表示进一步减少了高斯属性的冗余(刘等人,2024年;李等人,2025年).
场景适应性拉蒂丝向量化提高了锚基压缩的速率-扭曲效率(徐等人,2026年).
Gaussian pruning and spursization通过去除冗余原始物来减少模型大小(Hanson等人,2025年;Zhang等人,2025年).
可差速率-扭曲优化直接平衡存储成本和场景优化期间的渲染质量(Wang等人,2024a).
基于Anchor的参数化代表当地高斯人有锚和可学习的抵消,同时预测锚的特性和取景条件的依赖视图的属性(Lu等人,2024年),为学习的3DGS压缩提供了紧凑的表示.

blocks.en: 2.2 Context Modeling for 3DGS Compression
blocks.zh: 2.2 3DGS压缩的上下文模型

blocks.en:
Context modeling improves entropy coding by conditioning symbol probabilities on information available at the decoder, a principle widely used in learned image compression ( Ballé et al., 2018 ; Minnen et al., 2018 ) .
Applying this idea to irregular 3D representations is challenging because neighboring elements do not lie on dense regular grids.
HAC and HAC++ construct spatial context by querying a learned hash grid at anchor locations for anchor-attribute distribution modeling ( Chen et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2025 ) .
ContextGS instead builds a coarse-to-fine anchor hierarchy and conditions finer anchors on already decoded coarser anchors, together with a low-dimensional per-anchor hyperprior ( Wang et al., 2024b ) .
PCGS builds on the HAC++ framework with progressive masking and progressive quantization for incremental bitstreams ( Chen et al., 2026 ) .
These methods construct context through spatial feature fields or inter-anchor dependencies.
COSA-GS instead constructs context through causal dependencies among coordinates, latents, and attribute groups within each anchor, retaining conditional context modeling without spatial aggregation.
blocks.zh:
上下文模型在解码器可用信息上通过调节符号概率来改进 en编码,这个原理被广泛用于学习图像压缩(Ballé等人,2018年;Minnen等人,2018年).
将这个想法应用到不规则的3D表达方式中是具有挑战性的,因为相邻的元素不停留在密集的常规网格上.
HAC和HAC++通过查询锚地上学习的散列网,构建空间背景,用于锚地属性分布模型(Chen等人,2024年;Chen等人,2025年)。
背景情况 GS转而在已经解码的coarser锚上建立粗对细锚分级和条件更细锚,加上低维的每锚高额锚(Wang等人,2024年b) 。
PCGS基于HAC++框架,对增量位流进行渐进式遮盖和渐进式量化(Chen等人,2026年).
这些方法通过空间特征域或确定者之间的依赖关系构建上下文.
COSA-GS则通过每个锚地内的坐标组、潜伏组和属性组之间的因果依赖关系来构建上下文,保留条件上下文模型,而不进行空间聚合。

blocks.en: 2.3 Cross-Platform Decoding in Neural Compression
blocks.zh: 2.3 神经压缩中的跨平面解码

blocks.en:
Neural compression requires numerical consistency between the encoder and decoder, as even small differences in predicted probabilities can cause entropy-decoding failures. Ballé et al. (2019) address platform-dependent floating-point behavior using integer networks for learned image compression. Koyuncu et al. (2022) further study cross-device consistency through weight and activation quantization of entropy networks.
For video compression, DCVC-RT incorporates model integerization to support consistent cross-device coding ( Jia et al., 2025 ) .
Integer inference has also been developed for cross-platform lossless LiDAR point cloud compression ( Yu et al., 2026 ) .
An alternative approach transmits calibration information to correct numerical mismatches at the cost of additional side information ( Tian et al., 2023 ) .
COSA-GS applies integer inference to the context model of anchor-based 3DGS, maintaining consistency of entropy-decoded symbols across platforms.
blocks.zh:
神经压缩需要编码器和解码器之间的数值一致性,因为即使是预测概率的微小差异,也可能造成肽解码故障. Ballé等人著. (2019年)利用整数网络解决平台依赖的浮点行为,以学习到的图像压缩. Koyuncu 等人(2022年)通过重量和激活量子化的 en网络,进一步研究交叉装置的一致性.
为进行视频压缩,DCVC-RT整合模型整数化,支持一致的交叉设备编码(Jia等人,2025年).
还为跨平台无损LiDAR点云压缩开发了整数推论(Yu等人,2026年).
另一种办法是传送校准信息,以纠正数字不匹配现象,同时牺牲额外的副信息(Tian等人,2023年)。
COSA-GS将整数推论应用于基于锚的3DGS上下文模型,保持了跨平台的 en-解码符号的一致性.

blocks.en: 3.7 Integer Inference for Cross-Platform Decoding
blocks.zh: 3.7 跨平面解码的整数推论

blocks.en:
Cross-platform entropy decoding requires consistent context modeling at the encoder and decoder.
However, floating-point computations can produce platform-dependent numerical differences and lead to decoding failures.
We therefore implement the context model entirely in integer arithmetic to ensure bit-exact consistency of entropy-decoded symbols across platforms.

因此,我们完全用整数算术执行上下文模型,以确保各平台的肽-解码符号的位精确一致性。

blocks.en:

At inference, the corresponding operations are performed directly in integer arithmetic.

blocks.en: 4.1 Settings

blocks.en:
Experiments are conducted on Mip-NeRF360 ( Barron et al., 2022 ) , DeepBlending ( Hedman et al., 2018 ) , Tanks&Temples ( Knapitsch et al., 2017 ) , and BungeeNeRF ( Xiangli et al., 2022 ) .
We compare against ContextGS ( Wang et al., 2024b ) , HAC++ ( Chen et al., 2025 ) , CAT-3DGS ( Zhan et al., 2025 ) , PCGS ( Chen et al., 2026 ) , and SpeedyGS ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) .
We report dataset-average PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS for novel-view rendering, together with compressed scene size in MiB.
Higher PSNR and SSIM and lower LPIPS indicate better novel-view quality. The rate–distortion results of the compared methods are based on the per-scene metrics reported in the corresponding papers.

在Mip-NERF360(Barron等人,2022年),DeepBlending上进行了实验。 (Hedman等人,2018年),Tanks&Temples (Knapitsch等人,2017年),和BungeeNERF (Xiangli等人,2022年).
我们比较了背景GS(Wang等人,2024年b),HAC++(Chen等人,2025年),CAT-3DGS(Zhan等人,2025年),PCGS(Chen等人,2026年),以及SpedyGS(Zhang等人,2026年).
我们报告数据集平均PSNR,SSIM,和LPIPS用于小说视图渲染,同时在MiB中压缩场景大小.
较高的PSNR和SSIM以及较低的LPIPS都显示出更好的新颖视角质量. 比较方法的速率-扭曲结果以相应论文中报告的人均计量标准为基础。

We also evaluate 15+20K and 15+45K settings and a 15+30K quantization-aware training (QAT) variant.
Unless otherwise specified, experiments use an NVIDIA 5880 Ada GPU and an AMD EPYC 9654 CPU.
More implementation details are provided in the appendix and the repository.

blocks.en: 4.2 Performance Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.2 业绩分析

blocks.en:
Figure 3 compares the rate–distortion performance across the four datasets.
We first examine Mip-NeRF360, where the default 15+30K setting of COSA-GS achieves a favorable PSNR–size trade-off compared with existing methods, including HAC++ with 60K optimization steps.
As reported in Table 1 , COSA-GS covers 1.32–8.55 MiB and 26.54–27.94 dB on Mip-NeRF360, reaching 27.61 dB at 4.20 MiB.
Meanwhile, the SSIM and LPIPS curves also show better overall trade-offs than ContextGS, HAC++, CAT-3DGS, and PCGS at comparable sizes.
SpeedyGS achieves higher SSIM and lower LPIPS at several bitrate points, while COSA-GS provides a stronger PSNR–size trade-off.
On DeepBlending, Tanks&Temples, and BungeeNeRF, the default 15+30K setting similarly achieves favorable PSNR with smaller scene sizes than the compared methods.
On the flowers scene in Figure 2 , COSA-GS achieves a decoding time of 0.1279 s, compared with 24.95 s for HAC++ and 25.49 s for PCGS, while producing a smaller bitstream and slightly better rendering quality.
blocks.zh:
图3比较了四个数据集的比率-扭曲性能。
我们首先检查了Mip-NERF360,其中COSA-GS的默认15+30K设定与包括HAC++在内的现有方法相比,实现了有利的PSNR大小权衡,达到60K优化步骤.
如表1所示,COSA-GS涵盖: MIP-NERF360上的1.32–8.55 MiB和26.54–27.94 dB,在4.20 MiB上达到27.61 dB.
同时,SSIM和LPIPS曲线也比ContextGS,HAC++,CAT-3DGS和PCGS在可比尺寸上表现出更好的总体权衡.
速度GS在几个比特率点上实现了更高的SSIM和较低的LPIPS,而COSA-GS则提供了更强的PSNR大小的权衡.
在DeepBlending,Tanks&Temples,以及BungeeNERF上,默认的15+30K设置同样实现了PSNR的偏好,场景尺寸比比较方法要小.
在图2中的花朵场景上,COSA-GS实现了0.1279s的解码时间,而HAC++的解码时间为24.95s,PCGS的解码时间为25.49s,同时产生一个较小的比特流并略好一些的渲染质量.

blocks.en:
Figure 3 also compares different numbers of optimization steps.
Increasing the optimization steps generally improves rate–distortion performance, but the gain gradually diminishes and varies across datasets.
The improvement is more evident on Mip-NeRF360, DeepBlending, and Tanks&Temples, whereas the curves on BungeeNeRF remain close across the 15+20K, 15+30K, and 15+45K settings.
The QAT variant applies quantization-aware training together with the integer context-model inference described in Sec. 3.7 .
Its rate–distortion curves remain close to the floating-point 15+30K model over most bitrate points, with only small differences at some low-bitrate points on DeepBlending and BungeeNeRF.
Overall, these results show that the proposed anchor-wise context modeling is effective across the four benchmarks.

增加优化步骤一般会提高速率-扭曲性能,但收益逐渐减少,并因数据集而异.
改进在Mip-NERF360、DeepBlending和Tanks & Templles上更为明显,而BungeeNERF上的曲线在15+20K、15+30K和15+45K的设置上仍然很接近。
QAT变体与第3.7节中所述的整数上下文模型推论一起适用量化-认识训练.
其速率-扭曲曲线在大多数比特率点上仍然接近浮点15+30K模型,在DeepBlending和BungeeNERF上的一些低比特率点上只有小差异.
总的来说,这些结果表明,拟议的基于锚地的环境模型在四个基准中是有效的。

blocks.en:
Figure 4 compares the full model with variants that remove the geometry context, the anchor latent, or both.
Removing either source causes a small degradation, indicating that the two context sources provide complementary information.
When both are removed, performance drops noticeably across all bitrate points, showing that anchor context is essential to the compression performance of COSA-GS.
The geometry-free variant remains close to the full model, further indicating that the learnable anchor latent can provide informative context even without coordinate conditioning.

消除任何一种来源都会导致小幅退化,表明两个上下文来源提供了补充信息。
当两者被移除时,在所有比特率点上性能明显下降,表明锚定上下文对COSA-GS的压缩性能至关重要.
无几何变体仍然接近全模型,进一步表明可以学习的锚潜能提供信息背景,即使没有坐标条件.

blocks.en:
COSA-GS uses a scalar position scaling for each anchor to scale its offsets uniformly.
To examine whether additional directional flexibility benefits compression, we replace the scalar with a three-dimensional vector.
Figure 4 shows that this variant provides no overall rate–distortion improvement and slightly degrades performance at high bitrate points.
The additional scaling degrees of freedom therefore increase the amount of scaling information to be coded without providing sufficient quality gains to offset the added rate.
blocks.zh:
COSA-GS使用每个锚标的标尺位置缩放来统一缩放其抵消.
为了检查额外的方向灵活性是否有利于压缩,我们用三维矢量取代了scalar.
图4显示,该变体没有总体的速率-扭曲改善,在高比特率点的性能略有下降.
因此,自由度的增加增加了要编码的缩放信息的数量,而没有提供足够的质量收益来抵消增加的费率。

blocks.en:
The right panel of Figure 4 evaluates the number of channels used for the context, anchor feature, and anchor latent.
Increasing the context channels from 24 to 32 provides little improvement.
Increasing the feature channels from 32 to 50 slightly improves PSNR at the highest bitrate point but degrades performance at lower bitrates.
Changing the number of latent channels from the default four to either one or eight also yields similar rate–distortion curves, with no consistent gain from using more latent channels.
Overall, increasing the number of channels provides limited benefit, supporting the default configuration of COSA-GS.

将背景渠道从24个增加到32个没有什么改进。
将特性通道从32个增加到50个,在最高比特率点上略微改善PSNR,但在较低的比特率下降低性能.
将潜在通道的数量从默认的4个改为1个或8个,也会产生类似的速率-扭曲曲线,而使用更多潜在通道不会获得一致的收益。
总体而言,增加渠道数量能提供有限的好处,支持COSA-GS的默认配置.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
We presented COSA-GS, an anchor-wise causal framework for compact 3DGS compression without spatial context aggregation.
A compact anchor latent is modeled from coordinate-derived geometry context and then fused with this context to provide context for attribute coding, yielding a simple context model composed only of linear transformations and activations.
Combined with rate–distortion optimization, quantization-aware training, and integer inference, COSA-GS achieves strong compression performance, fast decoding, and cross-platform consistency.
Experiments across four benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of this simple anchor-wise architecture for practical 3DGS compression.
blocks.zh:
我们介绍了COSA-GS,这是不进行空间环境聚合的紧凑3DGS压缩的主因框架。
从坐标生成的几何上下文模拟一个紧凑的锚潜,然后与上下文结合,为属性编码提供上下文,生成一个仅由线性转换和激活组成的简单上下文模型。
COSA-GS与速率-扭曲优化,量子化-意识训练,和整数推论相结合,实现了强压缩性能,快速解码,跨平台一致性.
跨越四个基准的实验显示,这种简单的锚定结构对于实用的3DGS压缩是有效的.

blocks.en: This appendix provides implementation and runtime details, bit allocation analysis, extended rate–distortion comparisons, additional ablation studies, and detailed results for individual scenes.

blocks.en: A.1 Dataset configuration
blocks.zh: A.1 数据集配置

blocks.en:
We follow the image-resolution settings and training/test view splits used in the publicly released code of Scaffold-GS, HAC++, PCGS, and CAT-3DGS.
We evaluate on nine scenes from Mip-NeRF360, two from Tanks&Temples, two from DeepBlending, and six from BungeeNeRF.
Images wider than 1,600 pixels are downsampled to a width of 1,600 while preserving their aspect ratio, and smaller images retain their original resolution.
Views are sorted by image filename before splitting.
For Mip-NeRF360, Tanks&Temples, and DeepBlending, every eighth view, starting from the first, is held out for testing, and the remaining views are used for training.
For BungeeNeRF, the first 31 views are used for testing and the remaining views for training.

我们遵循Scafold-GS、HAC++、PCGS和CAT-3DGS等公开发布的代码中使用的图像分辨率设置和培训/测试视图分割。
我们从Mip-NERF360,Tanks&Temples,DeepBlending,以及BungeeNERF的六个场景来评价。
大于1600像素的图像在保持其侧面比的同时被下取样到1600的宽度,较小的图像保留了原来的分辨率.

blocks.zh: A.2 位分配。

blocks.en:
Figure 5 shows the bitstream composition at three rate settings on Mip-NeRF360.
Anchor features and offsets account for most of the bitstream, contributing 77.3% at λ = 0.0006 \lambda=0.0006 and 53.8% at λ = 0.008 \lambda=0.008 .
Anchor latents contribute 3.4%–8.5%, providing context for multiple attribute distributions with a comparatively small cost.
As the total rate decreases, the fraction of anchor coordinates increases from 5.8% to 15.4%, while the fraction of model parameters and metadata increases from 0.6% to 3.9%.
The low-rate bitstreams therefore allocate a larger fraction to anchor coordinates, model parameters, and metadata as the coding costs of features and offsets decrease.

锁定潜伏物贡献了3.4~8.5%,为成本相对较小的多重属性分布提供了上下文.

因此,低速位流将更大的分数分配给锚定坐标、模型参数和元数据,作为特性和抵消的编码费用。

blocks.en: A.3 Runtime measurement
blocks.zh: A.3 运行时间测量

blocks.en:
We measure encoding and decoding times after one warmup run in the same process.
For encoding–decoding evaluation, we first encode the trained model and decode the resulting bitstream as a warmup, then repeat the complete procedure and record the encoding and decoding times separately.
For decoding-only evaluation, we decode the same bitstream once as a warmup and measure the second decoding run.
Warmup is excluded from the reported times.
blocks.zh:
我们测量编码和解码时间 在一个热量运行 在同一过程。
对于编码–解码评价,我们首先将训练过的模型编码,然后将由此产生的比特流解码为热点,然后重复完整的程序,分别记录编码和解码时间.
对于解码唯一的评价,我们一次解码同样的比特流作为热量,并测量第二次解码运行.
温暖被排除在报告时间之外。

blocks.en:
We use a host wall clock and synchronize CUDA immediately before and after each measured encoding or decoding call.
Encoding starts from a trained model in memory and ends with an in-memory scene bitstream.
Decoding starts from that bitstream and an initialized decoder model, and ends with the coordinates, mask, attributes, and network parameters required for rendering.
Both intervals include context prediction, entropy coding, CPU–GPU transfers, and in-memory serialization or parsing.
Checkpoint loading, scene-file input/output, decoder-model construction, rendering, and image-quality evaluation are excluded.
For the QAT variant, encoding time includes exporting the quantized networks. Decoding time excludes constructing empty integer-network modules but includes restoring and transferring their parameters.
blocks.zh:
我们使用一个主机墙钟,在每一个测量编码或解码呼叫的前后,立即同步CUDA.
编码从内存中训练有素的模型开始,以内幕比特流结束.
解码从该位流和一个初始化的解码器模型开始,最后是渲染所需的坐标,遮罩,属性和网络参数.
两个间隔都包括上下文预测, en编码,CPU–GPU传输,以及内膜序列化或解析.
检查点加载,场景文件输入/输出,解码器模型构建,渲染,图像质量评价被排除在外.
对于QAT变体,编码时间包括输出量化网络. 解码时间不包括构建空整数网络模块,但包括恢复和转移其参数.

blocks.en:
We use a CPU rANS backend with 16-bit probability precision.
Each Gaussian-coded stream is split into four independent blocks by default and processed by up to four CPU worker threads.
Coordinate occupancy and offset mask use categorical coding with transmitted CDFs.
Coordinate- and attribute-coder times are measured with host timers, without synchronization at every component boundary.
Context-network time is additionally measured with CUDA events.
These component times are diagnostic rather than an exclusive decomposition: a host interval may wait for GPU work already counted by the event timer, and asynchronously submitted work may finish outside that host interval.
blocks.zh:
我们使用带有16位概率精度的CPU ranS后端.
每个高斯码流默认分为四个独立块,并由最多四个CPU工人线程处理.
坐标占用和抵消面具使用与传输的CDF的绝对编码.
坐标-和属性-编码时间用宿主定时器进行测量,不在每个组件边界同步.
以CUDA事件额外衡量背景网络时间.
这些组件时间是诊断时间,而不是独家分解时间:主机间隔可能等待事件计时器已经计算的GPU工作,同步提交的工作可能在主机间隔之外完成.

blocks.en:
The rate–distortion training timer starts after data and model initialization and stops after the optimization loop, before the final checkpoint save and evaluation.
It includes pruning, logging, periodic evaluation, and checkpoint writing.
The preceding 15K Scaffold-GS initialization is timed separately.

blocks.en:
The scene bitstream stores the integer network parameters, rescaling parameters, reconstruction steps, coordinate metadata, mask CDF, compressed streams, and FP16 rendering-network parameters.
Decoding also requires the project source code, the model configuration files, and the shared Gaussian and GELU tables. These shared resources are not counted in the scene size.
For the same bitstream, consistency follows along the causal order: identical coordinates produce identical context inputs, the integer networks produce identical means and CDF indices, and the decoded residuals yield identical causal reconstructions.
Parallel entropy blocks write to fixed output slices, so their scheduling does not change the decoded sequence.
This guarantees consistency of entropy-decoded symbols and their fixed-point causal states, not bitwise equality of floating-point rendering.
In our experiments, we verify cross-platform consistency by checking exact equality of the entropy-decoded symbols for anchor latents, anchor attributes, offset masks, and the decoded integer anchor coordinates.

场景比特流存储整数网络参数,调整参数,重建步骤,协调元数据,遮盖CDF,压缩流,以及FP16渲染网络参数.
解码还需要项目源代码,模型配置文件,以及共享的高斯和GELU表格. 这些共享资源不计入场景大小.
对于相同的位流,一致性遵循因果顺序:相同的坐标产生相同的上下文输入,整数网络产生相同的手段和CDF指数,解码后的剩余部分产生相同的因果重建.
平行的 en块写入固定输出切片,因此它们的排程不会改变解码序列.
这保证了Entropy-decoded符号及其固定点因果状态的一致性,而不是浮点渲染的位法平等.
在我们的实验中,我们通过检查锚潜、锚属性、抵消口罩以及解码整数锚定坐标的精确等值,来验证跨平台的一致性。

blocks.en: A.5 Additional Rate–Distortion Results
blocks.zh: A.5 额外比率-扭曲结果

blocks.en:
Figure 6 presents PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS against scene size on all four datasets.
Alongside existing methods, we compare the 15+45K, 15+30K, and 15+20K settings of COSA-GS and the 15+30K quantization-aware training (QAT) variant.
blocks.zh:
图6列出了PSNR,SSIM,以及所有四个数据集的场景大小对比的LPIPS.
除了现有方法之外,我们还比较了COSA-GS的15+45K、15+30K和15+20K的设置以及15+30K量化-认识培训(QAT)变体。

blocks.en:
Increasing the number of optimization steps generally improves the PSNR–size trade-off on Mip-NeRF360, DeepBlending, and Tanks&Temples.
On Tanks&Temples, the 15+45K setting also improves SSIM and LPIPS over much of the bitrate range.
On Mip-NeRF360 and DeepBlending, the SSIM–size and LPIPS–size curves remain close across the three training settings.
On BungeeNeRF, the 15+20K and 15+45K settings yield similar rate–distortion performance across all three metrics.
blocks.zh:
增加优化步骤的数目一般会改善PSNR-大小在Mip-NERF360、DeepBlending和Tanks & Temples上的取舍。
在坦克上( O) Temples,15+45K设置也改进了SSIM和LPIPS在比特率范围的大部分.
在Mip-NERF360和DeepBlending上,SSIM的大小曲线和LPIPS的大小曲线在三个训练环境之间仍然很接近.
在 BungeeNERF 上, 15+20K 和 15+45K 设置在所有3 个度量中得出了相似的比率-扭曲性能.

blocks.en:
The 15+30K QAT variant combines quantization-aware training with integer inference for the context model.
Its rate–distortion curves remain close to those of the floating-point 15+30K model across most bitrate points, with small quality losses at some low-bitrate points on DeepBlending and BungeeNeRF.
blocks.zh:
15+30K QAT变体结合了量化-意识训练与上下文模型的整数推论.
其速率-扭曲曲线仍然接近跨越大多数比特率点的浮点15+30K模型,在DeepBlending和BungeeNERF上的一些低比特率点质量损失很小.

blocks.en: A.6 Additional Ablation Studies
blocks.zh: A.6 额外缺陷研究

blocks.en:
Figure 7 extends the main-paper ablations to all three quality metrics under the 15+30K setting.
The first row examines context sources and position scaling, while the second row examines the numbers of context, feature, and latent channels.
blocks.zh:
图7根据15+30K的设定,将主纸笔画扩大到所有三个质量衡量标准。
第一行审查上下文来源和位置缩放,第二行审查上下文、特征和潜在渠道的数目。

blocks.en:
Removing both geometry context and anchor latents produces the clearest degradation at low bitrate points, with lower PSNR and SSIM and higher LPIPS.
Retaining either context source recovers much of this loss, showing that each provides informative context.
Combining the two sources yields a favorable overall rate–distortion trade-off.
Replacing scalar position scaling with a three-dimensional vector provides no consistent improvement across the three metrics.

保留其中任一上下文来源可收回大部分损失,表明每个来源都提供了信息。
将这两个来源结合起来,会产生有利的总体比率-扭曲权衡。
用三维矢量取代标尺位置的缩放,无法在三个度量标准之间提供一致的改进。

blocks.en:
Increasing the number of context channels from 24 to 32 has little effect on rate–distortion performance across the three metrics.
Increasing the number of feature channels from 32 to 50 slightly improves PSNR at the highest bitrate point but degrades performance across all three metrics at the lowest bitrate point.
Using one or eight latent channels yields rate–distortion curves close to those of the default four-channel setting.
These results show no consistent benefit from increasing the number of channels, supporting the default configuration.
blocks.zh:
将上下文频道的数目从24个增加到32个,对三个衡量标准的比率扭曲性能影响不大。
将特性通道的数量从32个增加到50个,在最高比特率点的PSNR略有改进,但在最低比特率点降低所有三个度量的性能.
使用一个或八个潜在通道的输出率-扭曲曲线接近默认的四通道设置。
这些结果显示,增加频道数量,支持默认配置,没有一贯的好处.

blocks.en: A.7 Detailed Results and Coding Times
blocks.zh: A.7 详细结果和编码时间

blocks.en:
Tables 3 , 4 , 5 , and 6 report dataset-average reconstruction quality, compressed scene size, and total encoding and decoding times for the 15+45K, 15+30K, 15+30K QAT, and 15+20K settings, respectively.
Detailed per-scene results are provided in Tables 7 – 10 for 15+45K, Tables 11 – 14 for 15+30K, Tables 15 – 18 for 15+30K QAT, and Tables 19 – 22 for 15+20K.
Within each group, the tables report Mip-NeRF360, DeepBlending, Tanks&Temples, and BungeeNeRF results in that order.
Runtime measurements use the reference platform with an NVIDIA 5880 Ada GPU and an AMD EPYC 9654 CPU.
Table 23 lists the software versions used on this platform.

表7-表10为15+45K,表11-表14为15+30K,表15-18为15+30KQAT,表19-表22为15+20K。

表23列出了本平台使用的软件版本.

blocks.en:
For each dataset, the 15+30K setting produces smaller bitstreams than the 15+20K setting at every tested rate weight λ \lambda .
Extending the number of rate–distortion optimization steps from 30K to 45K increases PSNR at every listed λ \lambda , with a small increase in scene size.
On BungeeNeRF, the 15+20K setting produces larger bitstreams and higher rendering quality than the 15+30K setting at the same λ \lambda , while the corresponding rate–distortion curves remain close.
blocks.zh:
对于每个数据集,15+30K的设置产生的位流比15+20K的设置要小,每测试的速率重量QQ\lambda .
将速率-扭曲优化步骤从30K扩展至45K,每列出的QQ\lambda都会增加PSNR,场景大小会小幅增加.
在BungeeNERF上,15+20K的设置产生比15+30K的设置更大的比特流和更高的渲染质量,在同一的QQ\lambda上,而相应的速率–扭曲曲线仍然保持接近.

blocks.en:
Across the three floating-point settings, dataset-average encoding times range from 0.0240 to 0.1752 s, and decoding times range from 0.0264 to 0.1839 s.
The dataset-average encoding and decoding times remain below 0.24 s at every tabulated bitrate point.
blocks.zh:

数据集平均编码和解码时间在每个列表比特率点都保持在0.24s以下.
